paragraphs: Rav Mari bar Avuha said in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak; [Pesachim 83a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.83a.5) and [Chullin 125a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.125a.10).[^1]

notes.text: Both passages transmit the same ruling in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name. Pesachim gives Rav Mari bar Avuha, while the consulted Chullin has Mari bar Avuha.
